title: Hexagonally binned density
intent: Reveal the relationship between automobile weight and fuel economy by aggregating raw observations into fixed-pixel hexagonal bins.

ai.create: Create a responsive hexbin density chart from the Cars dataset's weight and fuel-economy fields. Use each library's semantic hexbin transform or mark with a 24-pixel bin width and threshold color.
ai.maintain: Change bin width and thresholds while preserving raw-row lineage, fixed-pixel bins, stable keys, and cast-free channels.
